submissions.name: particle-diffusion
submissions.description: Study A1 baseline: 20,000 free particles from the centre cell, D = 1, binned onto the 11×11 grid.

submissions.name: field-modulated-decay
submissions.description: Study A2 baseline: static particles decaying at k·B(x) with a linear B field.

submissions.name: field-modulated-decay-continuum
submissions.description: Study A2 continuum-limit variant: 20,000 diffusing particles, Gaussian B, D_B = 0.5.

submissions.name: two-way-exchange
submissions.description: Study A3 baseline: A_particle ⇌ B_field (k1 = 1, k2 = 0.5, B₀ = 0.2 µM) on the 11×11×3 slab.

submissions.name: bimolecular-slab
submissions.description: Study A4 baseline: A_particle + B_field → C_field, k = 1/(µM·s), B₀ = 0.5 µM.

submissions.name: bimolecular-k2-step1
submissions.description: Study A5 baseline: bimolecular slab at k = 2 with the Smoldyn step equal to the PDE step.

submissions.name: bimolecular-k2-step16
submissions.description: Study A5 variant: the same with Smoldyn stepping once per 16 PDE steps (coupling interval 0.08 s).

submissions.name: bimolecular-perf
submissions.description: Study A6 baseline: the bimolecular slab timed to t = 1 s.

submissions.name: calcium-sparks-test1
submissions.description: Study C1 baseline: Schaff 2016 Test 1, 24 channels on the 4×6 lattice, separable kinetics, dt = 5 ms.

submissions.name: calcium-sparks-test2
submissions.description: Study C2 baseline: Schaff 2016 Test 2, opening rate k_on·U/U0 coupled to the field, fast diffusion, dt = 0.2 ms.

submissions.name: fokker-planck-test3
submissions.description: Study C3: one trial of Test 3 (fast diffusion, α = β = 1, a = 24, τ = 30, Δτ = 0.002); the ensembles ran as blocks earlier (runs/compose/).

submissions.name: two-way-exchange-from-sbml
submissions.description: Study B1 baseline: the two-way exchange model as its SBML round trip defines it, t = 2 s.

submissions.name: bimolecular-fenicsx-lumped
submissions.description: Study B2 baseline: the bimolecular slab with the FEniCSx Q1 engine (lumped mass) in place of FV.

submissions.name: bimolecular-fenicsx-consistent
submissions.description: Study B2 variant: FEniCSx Q1 with the consistent mass matrix.

submissions.name: ball-conversion
submissions.description: Study B2a baseline: A_p → B_f in a gmsh ball (R = 4 µm, h = 0.8), FEniCSx P1 + Smoldyn confined by the mesh.

submissions.name: ball-exchange
submissions.description: Study B2a variant: A_p ⇌ B_f in the same ball.

submissions.name: ball-conversion
submissions.description: Study B2b co-simulation: A_p → B_f in the ball (centre 4.5, R = 4, h = 0.8) that native VCell also ran.

submissions.name: ball-exchange
submissions.description: Study B2b co-simulation: A_p ⇌ B_f in the same ball.

submissions.name: ball-conversion
submissions.description: Study B2c: the B2b ball conversion, whose near-membrane B profile the study measures.

submissions.name: ball-conversion-grid-sphere
submissions.description: Study B2d variant grid_sphere: Pᵀ grid transfer, particles confined by the analytic sphere.

submissions.name: ball-conversion-positions-sphere
submissions.description: Study B2d variant positions_sphere: exact P1 load from positions, analytic sphere.

submissions.name: ball-conversion-grid-mesh
submissions.description: Study B2d variant grid_mesh: Pᵀ grid transfer, particles confined by the mesh boundary.

submissions.name: ball-conversion-positions-mesh
submissions.description: Study B2d variant positions_mesh: exact P1 load from positions, mesh boundary.

submissions.name: ball-conversion-corrected
submissions.description: Study B2e: A_p → B_f on VCell's own realization of the ball, adapters + accessible volumes.

submissions.name: ball-conversion-none
submissions.description: Study B2e: the same with no correction (VCell's full voxel volumes).

submissions.name: ball-exchange-corrected
submissions.description: Study B2e: A_p ⇌ B_f on VCell's realization, adapters + accessible volumes.

submissions.name: exchange-strang-k2
submissions.description: Study B2g: the k = 2 bimolecular slab under the SplittingCoordinator, Strang splitting, coupling 2·dt.

submissions.name: exchange-jacobi-k2
submissions.description: Study B2g: the same under Jacobi splitting.

submissions.name: dumbbell-mesh-conversion

submissions.description: Study B2f mesh path: A_p ⇌ B_f in the dumbbell.

submissions.description: Study B2f VCell-realization path: A_p → B_f, adapters + accessible volumes.

submissions.description: Study B2f VCell-realization path: A_p → B_f, no correction.
